Your project

WEBSITE
scope.

Your proposal confirms the pages, content, schedule, price, and any ongoing services.

  • Up to 5 pages, 20 tenant entries, and 10 availability entries
  • Your supplied directory, plans, photos, and leasing information
  • Mobile layout, broker inquiry form, and two revision rounds

A standard scope uses your approved content and a directory maintained through requested updates. Hosting, domain registration, and ongoing updates are itemized in the quote. Live data feeds, interactive maps, tenant portals, and extra content are scoped separately before work begins.

We reply within an hour during business hours, and we only use your details to answer you. No mailing lists.

Let’s talk

Questions

How long will it take?

Timing depends on the tenant directory, leasing information, photography, and approvals. Send the tenant list and your deadline so we can propose a schedule.

What happens when a tenant changes?

Agree who supplies changes and which updates the care arrangement covers. Hosting and ongoing updates are priced separately.

Can the site plan be interactive?

Yes, scoped separately from the main build. The La Paz Shopping Center page has an animated site plan with tenant logos. See the project.

Can you work with our existing photos and brand?

Yes. Send the photography, logo, brand guidelines, and any current website. New photography or brand work can be added if the project needs it.
